title: instruction_stage_result
description: Per-episode deterministic command-manager stage trace and recall computation.

required_stages.description: Stage IDs (or names) that the scenario declares as required.

fired_stages.description: Stage IDs that actually fired during the episode.

stage_order_fired.description: Time-ordered list of fired stage IDs.

recall.description: fired_required / required_total. Equals 1.0 iff episode_success clause satisfied.

order_correct.description: Fired stages are a permutation-subset of the required order.

response_deadline_violations.description: Stages whose first fire was later than stage_response_deadline_s after their trigger.
